faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Technical Support Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Jammu Technical Support Staff recruitment is 04 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Support Staff post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma or Degree or ITI in electrical, IT, or computer applications from a government-recognized institution with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are required for this position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 02 years of experience is required in IT systems or groundwork in electrical/passive networking, including experience in IT-based systems.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technical Support Staff position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Support Staff position is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Technical Support Staff role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 32,000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Jammu Technical Support Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting, a trade test/interaction, an interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. How should I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided apply online link on or before the last date of application.
